Court Filing Seeks to Block Trump's Name on US Institute of Peace Building

An urgent motion has been filed in court seeking to prevent the carving of former President Donald Trump's name onto the U.S. Institute of Peace building in Washington D.C. This legal action follows a similar effort to have his name inscribed on the Kennedy Center. The filing alleges a bid to engrave Trump's name on the Institute of Peace facade. The case is ongoing, with a judge being asked to intervene.
